mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.password, ro.name AS role, u.gender, u.year, u.nickname, u.last_login_at FROM social_account sa JOIN user u ON u.id = sa.user_id JOIN root r ON r.id = u.id AND r.type = 'USER' AND JOIN role ro ON ro.id = u.role_id WHERE sa.provider = #{provider} AND sa.provider_user_id = #{providerUserId}

SELECT user_id, provider, provider_user_id, provider_email, email_verified, display_name, avatar_url, created_at, updated_at, last_login_at FROM social_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND provider = #{provider}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO social_account (user_id, provider, provider_user_id, provider_email, email_verified, display_name, avatar_url) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{providerEmail}, #{emailVerified}, #{displayName}, #{avatarUrl})
